_comment: issue 1371: the ONE test-camera exposure baseline the E2E enforces at [0/8] over the bkshading USB-PTP path (scripts/lib/camera-test-settings.sh + scripts/camera_test_settings.py). Values are the raw gphoto2 --get-config values the bkshading relay uses: iso = ISO label, d002 = shutter ANGLE x100 (18000 = 180 deg), f-number = choice label like f/5.6, d004 = white balance Kelvin, d005 = tint. iso + d002 are REQUIRED; f-number/d004/d005 null = read and logged only. iso + d002 pinned 26.9.2026 from the owner-confirmed camera (ISO 8000, 1/1000 s at 60 fps = angle 21.6 deg): an absent camera now aborts the run unless acked as testcam.
